intro: Suggestions for improving the decision process and the site. None are implemented — review and choose a path before any change is built.

items.title: Confirm the 33 unverified WPT rows directly with the Wynn poker room
options: A) Email/call the Wynn poker room for written entry terms on each unverified WPT event.
B) Leave them unverified and decide only on Venetian data.
C) Treat WPT rows with similar names to verified re-entry events as re-entry (not recommended — inference).
items.tradeoff: A closes the biggest information gap. B is safest but leaves the WPT schedule unusable. C violates the no-inference rule.

items.title: Capture dated hotel quotes for Dec 6–13 at booking time
options: A) Manual capture from each official booking page into the rate log (checkout total, nightly average, fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline, timestamp).
B) Use the conditional poker rates as planning estimates.
C) Wait until 30 days out when cancellation windows matter.
items.tradeoff: A yields true cost numbers but is per-date manual work. B over/under-shoots. C is timed to cancellation deadlines.

items.title: Verify walk times on Google Maps before booking
options: A) Click each prefilled Google Maps link for the hotel–venue pairs you will use.
B) Accept the OSRM routing estimates.
C) Add a physical test walk on arrival.
items.tradeoff: A is the confirmation step the ≤30-minute rule deserves. B risks bridge/detour errors. C is too late for booking.

items.title: Add remaining poker rooms to the daily schedule pull
options: A) Add Palms, South Point, Orleans, The Strat, Golden Nugget official schedules to the morning monitor.
B) Keep Venetian/Wynn/Caesars/MGM scope.
C) Add only rooms with confirmed single-entry daily events.
items.tradeoff: A broadens the search for 8 AM starts and freezeout dailies. B is cheaper. C depends on discovery.

items.title: Resolve the Valuetown 'subsequent buy in's' wording
options: A) Ask the Venetian poker room in writing whether Events 18/58 are single-entry.
B) Keep them flagged and exclude from the plan.
C) Play them only as a fallback.
items.tradeoff: A settles it. B loses two $20K-guarantee options. C keeps exposure small.

items.title: Tighten event-duration estimates
options: A) Record actual finish times of the first events played and feed them back into the overlap logic.
B) Ask the tournament desk for typical durations.
C) Keep level-count estimates.
items.tradeoff: A self-corrects during the trip. B is quick. C is current state.

items.title: Quality ratings for hotels
options: A) AAA Diamond listings.
B) Forbes Travel Guide stars (Wynn Tower Suites statement already captured).
C) Keep class assumptions.
items.tradeoff: A and B are third-party verified ratings; C is assumption-based.

items.title: Merge the archived dashboards into this one
options: A) Keep archives as-is (current state) with links from the Archive page.
B) Delete after a review period.
C) Port any unique rows from archives into data/site/ (they are already merged).
items.tradeoff: A preserves prior sessions' work. B cleans up. C is already done by the integration pass.
